notes.title: Have a Vive? Check out Order Up VR!
notes.content:
Myself and a friend of mine have created a cooking sim called Order Up VR! 

We wanted to try out something new. Here's the trailer!

https://www.youtube.com/edit?o=U&video_id=ieOkOqqSLLQ

Steam Link:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/627220/Order_Up_VR/

notes.title: Release Details!
notes.content:
As mentioned in the greenlight, 16:9 will be supported in the game. Also, all those who buy the game will also get the premium pack that was sold on the web version. 

I will also be coordinating with ArmorGames to get the keys to those who purchased the game already on the web version!
